verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a graphics card. Bulk operations across many items is a software or data-management axis, so the question is a category error for GPU hardware. The one nearby mention is that the separate NVIDIA app can update DLSS settings across many games. That belongs to companion software and is a different feature, so it does not show the GPU itself ships a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
